zh.title: 美國航空將增設委內瑞拉巴塞隆納航線 2027年開航
zh.summary: 美國航空規劃2027年開航委內瑞拉巴塞隆納航線；其他美國航空公司也準備恢復航班
body: Simple Flying報導，美國航空（American Airlines）將在委內瑞拉航網中新增巴塞隆納（Barcelona）航點。報導以「成長中的委內瑞拉航網」形容這項新增安排。
根據報導標題所述，這條新航線預計於2027年開航。這是目前所見唯一與開航時間有關的資訊，報導未提供更精確的日期。
同一篇報導的摘要指出，在美國航空新增巴塞隆納航點的同時，其他美國航空公司也準備恢復飛往委內瑞拉的航班。
目前這則報導僅提供航點與預計開航年份，未說明這條航線的班次、使用機型、實際開航日期，也未說明相關航權或政府批准的狀態。
因此，這條航線目前屬於規劃中的安排，尚待更多細節與後續確認。

en.title: American Airlines to add Barcelona, Venezuela to network with 2027 route launch
en.summary: American Airlines plans a Barcelona, Venezuela route in 2027; other US carriers also prepare to restore flights
body: American Airlines is adding Barcelona to its growing Venezuela network, according to Simple Flying. The report describes the addition as part of a growing Venezuela network.
The route is reported to take off in 2027. That is the only timing detail in the report; no more precise date is given.
The same report says that, alongside the American Airlines addition, other US carriers are also preparing to restore flights to Venezuela.
The report provides only the destination and the reported launch year. It does not state frequency, aircraft type, an exact launch date, or the status of any route rights or government approvals.
The route therefore remains a planned addition pending further details and confirmation.

zh.title: FAA擬取得AI空管系統開發商股權，初步條款仍在協商
zh.summary: FAA擬取得Air Space Intelligence股權；初步條款正在協商
body: 根據內部機關文件，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）正尋求取得 Air Space Intelligence 的股權；該公司正在開發新的人工智慧支援空中交通管理系統。報導所述的初步條款包括讓政府以固定價格購買股份，FAA目前正就這項安排進行協商。該公司於2026年6月取得FAA合約，負責開發兩套相連的空中交通管理系統。
FAA於2026年9月21日起在華盛頓特區周邊有限度使用SMART。2026年10月9日，國會議員致函要求暫停在雷根國家機場（DCA）、杜勒斯國際機場（IAD）及巴爾的摩／華盛頓國際機場（BWI）使用該系統，並詢問已完成哪些安全評估、系統在惡劣天候或設備故障時的表現，以及人員接受的訓練。

en.title: FAA seeks stake in Air Space Intelligence, with terms still preliminary
en.summary: FAA is negotiating preliminary terms for a potential stake in Air Space Intelligence.
body: According to internal agency documents, the FAA is seeking an ownership stake in Air Space Intelligence, which is developing a new AI-supported air traffic management system. The reported preliminary terms would allow the government to buy shares at a set price, and the FAA is negotiating the arrangement. The company won an FAA contract in June 2026 to develop two connected systems for managing air traffic.

The FAA began using SMART on a limited basis around Washington, DC, on September 21, 2026. In an October 9, 2026, letter, lawmakers called for pausing its use at Reagan National (DCA), Dulles International (IAD) and Baltimore/Washington International (BWI). They asked about completed safety evaluations, performance during severe weather or equipment outages, and the training personnel received.

zh.title: 義大利航管資料網路故障後恢復全數空運能量
zh.summary: ENAV資料網路故障導致義大利航班大量取消；當日午後已修復並恢復正常容量
body: 義大利於2026年10月16日恢復全數空中交通容量。當日稍早，資料網路故障迫使航管單位大幅降低容量，導致全國旅客面臨航班延誤與取消。
飛航服務提供者ENAV表示，故障已修復、限制已解除，航班時刻逐步恢復正常。在幹擾最嚴重時，ENAV僅能處理約平常一半的空中交通量。
據航空分析公司Cirium統計，截至當地時間中午，義大利全國共有192個航班取消，航班時刻受到的幹擾更為廣泛。僅約31%的離場航班準時起飛，米蘭馬爾彭薩機場（MXP）降至25%，羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場（FCO）為28%。
問題起於支撐義大利全國航管服務的資料傳輸網路，發生時間在夜間。ENAV表示，備援系統最初讓管制員維持正常運作，但隨著上午交通量增加且故障持續，ENAV於當地時間06:00實施限制。
管制員在技術人員處理主要連線期間，倚賴次要的衛星網路。該備援維持了航管服務運作，但無法支撐全部航班量。ENAV其後通報容量提升至75%，接著確認主要網路完全正常、正常容量已恢復。
ENAV排除惡意活動，表示其航管設備運作正常，並將問題定調為系統之間傳輸資料的網路故障。ENAV表示，已與外部供應商合作調查並解決問題，其中包括負責管理與維護該資料網路的電信公司TIM。
羅馬、米蘭與貝加莫等地機場的旅客受影響最深。羅馬機場營運商ADR與米蘭機場營運商SEA建議旅客向航空公司查詢航班最新資訊。
zh.flash: 義大利航管資料網路故障 午後恢復全數容量

en.title: Italy restores full air traffic capacity after data network failure disrupts flights
en.summary: ENAV says network fault repaired and restrictions lifted; Cirium counted 192 cancellations across Italy by noon
body: Italy restored full air traffic capacity on October 16, 2026, after a data network failure earlier in the day forced controllers to sharply reduce capacity, leaving passengers facing delays and cancellations across the country.

Air navigation service provider ENAV said the fault had been repaired and restrictions lifted, with flight schedules gradually returning to normal. At the height of the disruption, ENAV could handle only about half the usual volume of air traffic.

By noon local time, aviation analytics company Cirium had counted 192 flight cancellations across Italy, with much wider disruptions to schedules reported. Only about 31% of departures had left on time, falling to 25% at Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP) and 28% at Rome Fiumicino (FCO).

The problems began overnight on the data transmission network supporting air traffic control services throughout Italy. ENAV said backup systems initially allowed controllers to maintain normal operations, but as morning traffic increased and the fault persisted, it introduced restrictions at 06:00 local time.

Controllers relied on a secondary satellite network while technicians worked on the primary connection. That backup kept air traffic control services running but could not support the full volume of flights. ENAV later reported that capacity had increased to 75%, before confirming that the primary network was fully functional and normal capacity had been restored.

The company ruled out malicious activity. It said its air traffic control equipment was functioning normally and identified the problem as a fault in the network carrying data between systems. ENAV said it worked with outside suppliers, including telecommunications company TIM, which manages and maintains the data network, to investigate and resolve the problem.

Passengers at airports serving Rome, Milan and Bergamo were among those most affected. Rome airport operator ADR and Milan airport operator SEA advised travelers to check with their airlines for flight updates.

zh.title: FAA與NATCA達成空管人員2.8%加薪協議
zh.summary: FAA與NATCA達成空管人員2.8%加薪協議，Oct. 18生效
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）與National Air Traffic Controllers Association（NATCA）達成協議，為空中交通管制員加薪2.8%。FAA新聞稿指出，調薪於Oct. 18生效，並追溯至年初。
協議也包括在空管設施採用打卡進出方式，讓管理人員掌握訓練與安全需求的相關資料。地方主管與工會代表將依預測工作量及營運需求制定班表指引；管制員調任則將著重於人力需求最嚴重的地點。

en.title: FAA and NATCA reach 2.8% pay deal for air traffic controllers
en.summary: FAA and NATCA agree to a 2.8% controller raise, effective Oct. 18.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Air Traffic Controllers Association (NATCA) have reached a deal to provide air traffic controllers with a 2.8% pay increase. The FAA said the increase takes effect Oct. 18 and is retroactive to the beginning of the year.

The deal also applies badge-in and badge-out time tracking at air traffic facilities, giving managers data to better track training and safety needs. Local managers and union representatives will develop shift guidelines based on forecasted workload and operational requirements. Controller reassignments will focus on locations where staffing needs are most severe.

zh.title: EASA發布2026年10月版機組人員易讀規則
zh.summary: EASA發布新版機組人員規則，納入旋翼機與飛行模擬訓練規範
body: 歐盟航空安全局（EASA）發布2026年10月版《機組人員易讀規則》（Easy Access Rules for Aircrew）。新版納入EASA ED Decision 2025/022/R，內容涉及旋翼機飛行員執照，以及旋翼機在日間與夜間目視飛行規則下的非商業運行。
新版也納入歐盟執委會實施規則（EU）2026/781，修訂飛行模擬訓練裝置的要求，以及此類裝置用於飛行員訓練、測試與檢查的規定；另收錄EASA ED Decision 2026/006/R，涉及具備FSTD能力簽章的飛行模擬訓練裝置資格及其在飛機與直升機型別訓練中的使用。EASA表示，規則提供強化版線上出版形式，也提供可供處理及同步使用的XML格式。

en.title: EASA publishes October 2026 revision of Easy Access Rules for Aircrew
en.summary: EASA publishes an aircrew rules revision incorporating gyroplane and flight-simulation regulatory material.
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has published its October 2026 revision of the Easy Access Rules for Aircrew. The revision incorporates EASA ED Decision 2025/022/R on flight crew licensing for gyroplanes and non-commercial gyroplane operations under visual flight rules by day and by night.

It also incorporates Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/781, which amends requirements for flight simulation training devices and their use in pilot training, testing and checking. EASA ED Decision 2026/006/R on qualification of devices with an FSTD capability signature and their use in aeroplane and helicopter type-rating training is included as well. EASA says the rules are available as an enhanced online publication and in machine-readable XML format.

zh.title: J-Air訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2更新機隊
zh.summary: J-Air訂購最多26架E190-E2，交付預計自2029年開始
body: 日本航空旗下區域航空公司J-Air將增加最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2。訂單包括16架確定訂單及10架選擇權；報導指出，這批飛機將取代該公司的E170與E190機隊，交付預計自2029年開始。
J-Air以大阪國際機場伊丹為營運據點，航網從北海道女滿別延伸至鹿兒島縣奄美羣島。報導列出的現有機隊為18架巴西航空工業170型及14架巴西航空工業190型，分別設有76席與95席。報導並指出，J-Air自2008年起營運巴西航空工業E-Jets。

en.title: J-Air orders up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 aircraft for fleet renewal
en.summary: J-Air orders up to 26 E190-E2s; deliveries are expected to begin in 2029
body: J-Air, the regional carrier of Japan Airlines, is adding up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 aircraft. The package comprises 16 firm orders and 10 options. The aircraft are intended to replace the carrier’s E170/E190 fleet, with deliveries expected from 2029, Aerospace Global News reported.

J-Air operates from Osaka International Airport, Itami, and its network spans Memanbetsu in Hokkaido to the Amami Islands in Kagoshima Prefecture. The report lists its current fleet as 18 Embraer 170s with 76 seats and 14 Embraer 190s with 95 seats. It also says J-Air has operated Embraer E-Jets since 2008.
